notes:
Fixes from your reports, plus two small additions to the pause menu.

The RAM and CPU undervolt tuners now find your games when your ROM folder is somewhere
other than the default. Before, they refused to start with "no GameCube or Wii game
found" while the launcher was visibly showing your games. The stability test also boots
from your save state properly now; on some consoles it was quietly starting the game
from its title screen instead, which tests far less of your memory.

Controllers: a pad whose Home button lives on a second internal device, like the CRKD
Nitro Deck, now opens the pause menu and can be mapped. And DraStic and PPSSPP use the
controller you assigned to port 1; before, both used whichever pad was connected first,
so setting a Pro Controller to port 1 changed nothing and its stick still did the wrong
thing.

Saving your performance overlay layout now closes the options panel and confirms it on
screen for a few seconds, instead of leaving you unsure whether it saved. The pause
menu's Performance section gains an Overlay location row that moves the readout between
the four corners and a bar across the top, live, while a game is running.
